topics.t: Should Japan accept more workers from other countries?
outline: 立場: Yes
理由1: 人口が減って、介護や農業で働く人が足りない
理由2: 多様な考えが新しいアイデアや経済の成長につながる
まとめ: 受け入れの準備(言語・生活の支援)も大切
qs: What kinds of support do foreign workers need when they come to Japan?
Do you think language barriers are a serious problem in the workplace?

topics.t: Is space exploration worth its cost?
outline: 立場: Yes
理由1: 衛星の技術が天気予報や通信など生活を支えている
理由2: 新しい技術が医療や環境の分野にも使われる
まとめ: 国どうしの協力で費用を分け合える
qs: Should private companies play a bigger role in space exploration?
Some people say the money should be spent on problems on Earth. What do you think?

topics.t: Can technology solve the problem of climate change?
outline: 立場: 一部は解決できる
理由1: 再生可能エネルギーや電気自動車で排出を減らせる
理由2: しかし技術だけでは不十分で、生活の変化も必要
まとめ: 技術と個人・政府の行動の両方が必要
qs: What can individuals do to reduce their carbon footprint?
Should air travel be more expensive to protect the environment?

topics.t: Should cities limit the use of cars in their centers?
outline: 立場: Yes
理由1: 渋滞と大気汚染が減る
理由2: 歩きやすい街は店や観光にも良い
まとめ: 公共交通を便利にすることが条件
qs: How would limiting cars affect people who live in the suburbs?
Do you think public transportation in Japan is good enough?

topics.t: Are online friendships as meaningful as face-to-face ones?
outline: 立場: No(同じではない)
理由1: 表情や体験を共有することで信頼が深まる
理由2: ただしオンラインは遠くの人や同じ趣味の人とつながれる
まとめ: 両方の良さを組み合わせるのが大切
qs: Do social media sites make people feel lonely?
Should schools teach students how to use social media safely?

steps.t: All right. Here is your topic card. You have one minute to choose one topic and prepare your speech. You can't take notes.
All right. Please begin your speech. You have two minutes.
Thank you. That is the end of the question period.

topics.t: Should more university classes in Japan be taught in English?
outline: 立場: Yes
理由1: 国際的に活躍できる人材を育てられる
理由2: 海外からの留学生や研究者を呼びやすくなる
まとめ: 内容の理解を助けるサポートも必要
qs: Wouldn't students understand difficult subjects better in Japanese?
Should English be taught from a younger age in Japan?

topics.t: Is globalization a threat to local cultures?
outline: 立場: No(脅威だけではない)
理由1: 海外からの関心が伝統文化を守る力になる(観光・ファン)
理由2: ただし大きなチェーン店などで町の個性が失われることもある
まとめ: 地域が自分たちの文化の価値を発信することが大切
qs: Can you give an example of a local tradition that is disappearing?
Should governments protect traditional industries from foreign competition?

topics.t: Should companies have a fixed retirement age?
outline: 立場: No
理由1: 年齢ではなく能力と健康で判断すべき
理由2: 人手不足の中、経験のある人の力が必要
まとめ: 働き方を選べる柔軟な制度が良い
qs: How can companies make use of older workers' experience?
Would older people continuing to work reduce opportunities for young people?

topics.t: Will artificial intelligence create more jobs than it destroys?
outline: 立場: 長い目で見ればYes
理由1: 産業革命のように、新しい技術は新しい仕事を生んできた
理由2: ただし変化の間に仕事を失う人を支える必要がある
まとめ: 学び直し(リスキリング)の支援がカギ
qs: What kinds of jobs do you think are most at risk from AI?
Who should pay for retraining workers who lose their jobs?

topics.t: Should more be done to protect endangered species?
outline: 立場: Yes
理由1: 生態系のバランスが崩れると、食料や薬など人間の生活にも影響する
理由2: 一度絶滅した種は二度と戻らない
まとめ: 生息地の保護と国際協力が必要
qs: Are zoos an effective way to protect endangered animals?
Should economic development ever come before protecting nature?

All right. Please begin your speech. You have two minutes.

topics.t: Is a four-day workweek realistic for Japan?
outline: 立場: 一部の業界ではYes
理由1: 休みが増えると集中力と生産性が上がるという試みの結果がある
理由2: しかし医療やサービス業などは人手不足で難しい
まとめ: 業界ごとに柔軟に取り入れるべき
qs: Do Japanese people work too much?
How would a shorter workweek affect small businesses?

topics.t: Should advertising aimed at children be restricted?
outline: 立場: Yes
理由1: 子どもは広告と情報の区別がつきにくい
理由2: お菓子やゲームの課金の広告が、健康やお金の問題につながる
まとめ: 親と学校がメディアの見方を教えることも大切
qs: Who is mainly responsible for what children watch: parents or companies?
Are online influencers a bad influence on young viewers?

topics.t: Are international sporting events worth the cost of hosting them?
outline: 立場: 条件付きでYes
理由1: 観光客が増え、国の魅力を世界に発信できる
理由2: しかし大会後に使われない施設が残るなど、費用の問題がある
まとめ: 今ある施設を使うなど、費用を抑える工夫が必要
qs: What should happen to stadiums after the event is over?
Do sporting events help improve relations between countries?

topics.t: Should the number of tourists be limited at popular destinations?
outline: 立場: Yes
理由1: 混雑やごみで住民の生活が苦しくなる(オーバーツーリズム)
理由2: 自然や文化財が傷つくのを防げる
まとめ: 予約制や入場料で、量より質の観光へ
qs: Should foreign tourists pay higher prices than local people at tourist sites?
How can tourists be encouraged to visit less famous places?

topics.t: Is it important to preserve traditional crafts in modern society?
outline: 立場: Yes
理由1: 地域の歴史や技術を次の世代に伝えられる
理由2: 手作りの良さは海外でも評価され、地域経済の力になる
まとめ: 若い職人を育てる支援と、新しいデザインとの組み合わせ
qs: Why do you think fewer young people become craftspeople?
Can modern technology help traditional crafts survive?

topics.t: Should high-speed trains replace short-distance flights?
outline: 立場: 一部の路線ではYes
理由1: 鉄道は飛行機よりCO2の排出が少ない
理由2: 街の中心の駅から乗れるので、合計の移動時間が短いこともある
まとめ: 島や遠い地域には飛行機が必要なので、使い分けが大切
qs: Which do you prefer for long trips in Japan, trains or planes?
How do you think air travel will change in the next twenty years?

topics.t: Should people have the right to have their personal information removed from the Internet?
outline: 立場: Yes
理由1: 昔の失敗や個人情報がずっと残ると、仕事や生活に影響する
理由2: プライバシーは大切な権利
まとめ: ただし公共の利益(政治家の記録など)とのバランスが必要
qs: Do people share too much about themselves on social media?
Should search engine companies decide what information to remove?

topics.t: Should Japan invest more in renewable energy?
outline: 立場: Yes
理由1: 輸入に頼る燃料が減り、エネルギーが安定する
理由2: 温室効果ガスを減らせる
まとめ: 天気に左右される弱点は、電気をためる技術で補う
qs: What kind of renewable energy is most suitable for Japan?
Should people pay more for electricity to support clean energy?

topics.t: Is it acceptable to use animals in scientific research?
outline: 立場: 厳しい条件付きでYes
理由1: 新しい薬やワクチンの安全性の確認に役立ってきた
理由2: ただし動物の苦痛を最小限にする責任がある
まとめ: コンピューターや培養細胞など、代わりの方法の開発を進める
qs: Should cosmetics companies be allowed to test products on animals?
Do you think technology can completely replace animal testing?

topics.t: Should computer programming be a required subject in elementary schools?
outline: 立場: Yes
理由1: 筋道を立てて考える力が身につく
理由2: これからの社会でデジタルの知識は欠かせない
まとめ: 先生の研修と、ほかの教科とのバランスが必要
qs: Are there enough teachers who can teach programming?
Do children spend too much time using computers and tablets?

topics.t: Is a university degree necessary for success today?
outline: 立場: No(必ずしも必要ではない)
理由1: オンライン講座や仕事の経験で専門的なスキルを身につけられる
理由2: ただし医師やパイロットのように専門の教育や資格が必要な仕事もある
まとめ: 目標に合わせて学び方を選ぶことが大切
qs: Should companies stop caring about which university applicants went to?
Is university education too expensive in Japan?

topics.t: Should cities spend more money on public spaces such as parks?
outline: 立場: Yes
理由1: 運動や休息の場になり、住民の健康に良い
理由2: 地域の人どうしの交流が生まれる
まとめ: 災害のときの避難場所としても役立つ
qs: How can parks be made more useful for elderly people?
Should some parks be used for housing in crowded cities?

topics.t: Will remote work change where people choose to live?
outline: 立場: Yes
理由1: 毎日通勤しなくてよいので、家賃の安い地方に住める
理由2: 地方の人口が増え、地域の経済が元気になる可能性がある
まとめ: ただし通信環境や仕事の種類によって差がある
qs: What are the disadvantages of working from home?
Should companies let employees choose where they work?

topics.t: Should genetically modified foods be more widely accepted?
outline: 立場: 安全の確認を条件にYes
理由1: 病気や乾燥に強い作物で、食料不足を減らせる
理由2: 農薬の使用を減らせる場合もある
まとめ: 表示をわかりやすくして、消費者が選べるようにする
qs: Why do you think many consumers are worried about genetically modified foods?
How can the world solve the problem of food shortages?

topics.t: Is international cooperation the key to solving global health problems?
outline: 立場: Yes
理由1: 感染症は国境をこえて広がるので、一つの国だけでは防げない
理由2: 技術やワクチンを分け合うと、世界全体が安全になる
まとめ: 国際機関を通じた情報の共有と資金の協力が必要
qs: Should rich countries do more to help poorer countries improve their health care?
What lessons did the world learn from the COVID-19 pandemic?

ek1_free.q: Please tell me a little about yourself.
ek1_free.ja: 少し自己紹介をしてください。
model: I'm a student, and I'm interested in aviation. I'm studying English because I want to work as an international pilot.
points: 落ち着いて2〜3文

ek1_free.q: What are you interested in these days?
ek1_free.ja: 最近、何に興味がありますか。
model: Recently, I've been interested in new airplane technology, such as planes that use cleaner fuel.
points: 具体的に

ek1_free.q: How do you usually spend your weekends?
ek1_free.ja: ふだん週末をどう過ごしますか。
model: I usually study in the morning and go cycling in the afternoon. It helps me relax.
points: 具体的に2文

ek1_free.q: Why are you taking the Grade 1 test?
ek1_free.ja: なぜ1級を受けるのですか。
model: I want to use English in my future job, and I think this test is a good goal to aim for.
points: 理由をはっきり

ek1_free.q: What kind of books or articles do you read?
ek1_free.ja: どんな本や記事を読みますか。
model: I often read articles about science and technology. I also like history books.
points: ジャンル + 一言

ek1_free.ja: 海外に行ったことはありますか。
model: Yes, I went to Australia on a school trip. It was a great chance to use English.
points: Yes / No のあとに具体例
